summary: "World model" first appears in this evidence in 1930s–1970s relativistic cosmology, where it meant a mathematical model of the whole universe (expanding, steady-state, Friedmann). From the 1980s it was taken up in AI and robotics for an agent's internal representation of its environment, and today it mostly means a learned, often generative neural model that predicts how an environment evolves in response to actions, used for planning in robotics, autonomous driving, video generation and language-model agents.
